description: This file defines the CartActivity class, an Android activity responsible for managing the shopping cart UI in an online shopping platform. It handles displaying cart items, applying coupons, editing quantities, removing items, and proceeding to checkout. The activity interacts with a ViewModel (CartViewModel) for data management and uses RecyclerView with swipe-to-delete functionality, Snackbars for user feedback, and dialogs for confirmation actions.

classes.name: CartActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the shopping cart UI, including item list, coupon application, quantity updates, deletion, and navigation to checkout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and binds ViewModel data.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the toolbar with title and back navigation.

methods.name: setupRecycler
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView with adapter and swipe-to-delete functionality.

methods.name: attachSwipeToDelete
methods.description: Attaches swipe gesture to RecyclerView items for removal with undo option.

methods.name: setupActions
methods.description: Sets up click listeners for buttons like clear cart, checkout, browse, apply/remove coupon.

methods.name: openCheckout
methods.description: Starts the CheckoutActivity for order placement.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from checkout activity, shows confirmation Snackbar.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Binds LiveData from ViewModel to UI updates for cart items, totals, quantity, and button states.

methods.name: bindCouponUi
methods.description: Binds coupon-related UI updates and validation state changes.

methods.name: bindErrorsAndIdentity
methods.description: Handles error events and user email identity prompts.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles toolbar menu actions, particularly back navigation.
